model.title: Alaska Native Landless Equity Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Lisa Murkowski (R-AK)

summary.text: The bill would allow five Alaska Native communities in Southeast Alaska—Haines, Ketchikan, Petersburg, Tenakee, and Wrangell—to form urban corporations and receive land from the federal government. It directs the Department of the Interior to transfer specified land and related assets like roads and trails to each community, while also allowing them to establish settlement trusts to support education, health, welfare, and cultural preservation.
